source_conflicts_resolved: Erroneous printed Darkest Secret no-faceup-adviser parenthetical replaced by errata and matching-suit main rule.
Errata corrects Imperial entire-side power meanings while retaining own-site/own-board exceptions and declared defender priority.
Campaign force follows amended 5.5.2; selected dice do not define force.
Citizen Supply refresh matches exact Chancellor space, including leftmost.
Supremacy title transfer deferred to Campaign end; title bonus is Campaign modifier.
Corrected adviser limit is used before playing; lowest simultaneous limit applies.
Chronicle excludes offering Citizenship to oneself; all ruin attachments include surviving denizens.
Corrected Draw keyword does not import Search stop procedure into unrelated powers; world Vision counter still advances.
Chronicle aid printed top-stack 12 denizens is replaced by governing 10 denizens plus 2 Visions.
Law literal optional banishment/favor burn and precise sequence govern over abbreviated Playbook Campaign examples.
Site Reference governs all site powers, including Shrouded Wood choice precedence and same-suit Homeland condition.
conclusion: No source-fidelity errors, material procedural gaps, or applicable multiplayer rule omissions found after complete candidate, source-text, errata, and native-PDF review. Candidate has sufficient procedure and edge-case detail for the requested full base multiplayer scope.
